 Following two wins in qualifying, Lorenzo Sonego, who reached the quarters of this event a year ago, begins his main-draw campaign at the ATP event in Stockholm. The Italian will face the higher-ranked Quentin Halys, who didn't need to come through qualifying, which means that this will be his first match since touching down in the Swedish capital. The two players will face off for the third time as top-level professionals. 
 From a betting angle, 'Over 2.5 Sets' appeals at odds of +130. These two players have a history of playing out hard-fought matches that go the distance, which is exactly what happened when they met last year, while neither player has lost many matches in straight sets of late, so it's easy to feel that neither will give this up without putting a serious fight.
